items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Kevin; the mention occurs in the interviewer's turn ('To Kevin was home') without any response or connection from the interviewee.

ctx.x: When you're coming back down again? Maybe in July. I don't know this. But the one still talked to Lenny. She said she wanted to find out a few things.
She's got a fight. And one who was. To Kevin was home. But poor girl. The only bride. She ever got. Was one doll. They run her home. The seventh
